verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a first-party payment-link capability: links can be generated and shared with customers via email or chat. However, the docs present it mainly through the Payment Links API, which requires code. The only no-code claim is a single summary phrase, with no documented dashboard workflow for creating links. Missing for 10: documented dashboard (Web app) payment-link creation flow, explicit no-code setup steps, evidence of selling immediately without integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: With the Payment Links API you can generate a payment link to share with your customer. The payment link can for example be attached to an unpaid invoice or shared via email or chat applications.
plus no-code payment links through the Payment links API
